root_cause.text: The delayed work `mlo_scan_start_wk` was only canceled during restart cleanup but not during normal disconnection, allowing it to execute after the associated vif is freed (use-after-free) or after an interface type change (init-after-queue).
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `wiphy_delayed_work_cancel(&mld_vif->mlo_scan_start_wk)` call from `iwl_mld_cleanup_vif` (vif cleanup) to `iwl_mld_move_sta_state_down` (station state transition to disconnected), ensuring cancellation occurs before the vif is freed or interface is changed. The commit message explicitly notes that the work is not canceled on disconnection, only in restart cleanup, leading to the described issues.
